blurb: Guests paddle through scenic tide channels and explore remote beaches, encountering wildlife such as harbor seals, leopard sharks, river otters, and Tule Elk. They offer bioluminescence night tours, day tours, private tours, kayak rentals, and kayak camping. Group, scout, and school tours are available, as well as paddle classes to improve kayaking and SUP skills.

cancellation: More than 7 days prior to the event: Full refunds of any fees paid will be given during this time period, minus a 5% cancellation fee and (if applicable) the 6% Fareharbor booking fee. There is no charge for rescheduling during this time period. Within 7 days of the event: Your reservation is considered final, and all fees are due and payable. Unpaid balances may be charged.
policies: After this time no money will be refunded, except in the event of an inclement weather cancellation.
We attempt in all cases to determine prior to your tour launch if weather will impede your trip.
However, there are rare occasions where we have launched and weather patterns change suddenly at which time we must return to shore.
When the activity is cancelled post-embarkation and we must return within the first hour, patrons may reschedule to a future trip with a 50% refund.
When the tour is cancelled before we have embarked, patrons may reschedule the same trip on a future date (at no cost) or cancel completely.
In the event you choose to cancel you may receive a 100% refund (no cancellation fees). We look forward to seeing you!
